# A sign for when the printer fails

The ticket printer failed again and the new volunteer waited for permission to use handwritten tickets. Put the fallback beside the machine with a box of blank cards. The important step is allowing a person to continue serving visitors. [[Maintenance]] should name reversible decisions a volunteer can make without waiting for the manager.
